description: Source code implementing shell transport for the mcumgr SMP protocol in Zephyr RTOS, including frame parsing, timeout handling, and UART communication.

methods.name: smp_shell_input_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles input timeout event, clears escape state bits and resets buffer.

methods.name: read_mcumgr_byte
methods.description: Processes a byte to determine if it is a framing byte for mcumgr protocol and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: smp_shell_rx_bytes
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes, manages buffer, and detects complete frames.

methods.name: smp_shell_process
methods.description: Processes complete SMP frames from buffer queue and passes them to the mcumgr serial processor.

methods.name: smp_shell_get_mtu
methods.description: Returns the MTU size for the transport.

methods.name: smp_shell_tx_pkt
methods.description: Transmits a packet using mcumgr serial protocol.

methods.name: smp_shell_init
methods.description: Initializes the SMP shell transport, sets function pointers, and registers transport.
